# CANDIDATE: ORB_VWAP_BREAK_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

After the opening range is established, a retest of the ORB low followed by a decisive close above VWAP with elevated volume signals intraday buying pressure. This edge exists because the ORB low retest tests demand at the opening range support, while the VWAP break with volume confirmation indicates institutional participation and momentum continuation.

## Mechanism

Define the opening range (first 30 minutes) high and low. If price retraces to within 0.1% of the ORB low and then closes above VWAP on the same 5‑minute bar with volume > 1.5× the average volume of the prior 20 bars, enter long at the close. Exit: Stop placed at the ORB low minus 0.5×ATR(5); take profit at 2R or at the session high, whichever is reached first, with a runner trailed by a 15‑% ATR‑based chandelier exit.
